_about: Copy this file to docs/governance/skill-policy.json and edit it. The copy is
project-owned: the harness never manages it, so your edits are not drift.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by the gate.
skills_root  the installed skill tree(s). One string or a list. The release
fans out into every selected target root, so list the roots you
installed. A listed root that does not exist is skipped, which
is how selecting a subset of targets stays quiet.
skills       every skill that may exist there, mapped to its owning layer.
core    shipped by the release, receipt-owned;
profile shipped by a selected profile, receipt-owned;
local   authored by this project; must be covered by a lock
override and must not be receipt-owned.
The gate fails on any skill present on disk but absent here, and on any
skill listed here but missing on disk, so a hand-copied skill tree cannot
drift in silently. List the profile skills you actually selected.
